text: Yes, the property stayed free of fires throughout the period from October 5, 2026, to November 4, 2026. The analysis using NASA FIRMS data (VIIRS and MODIS sensors) detected zero fire events intersecting the asset. While sensor coverage was nearly complete—with only the last day (November 4) partially uncovered due to data delays—no thermal anomalies or active fires were recorded during the monitored timeframe.
